name: badge
title: Badge
description: A short label beside content: a record's status in a pill (subtle or bold), a live state as a dot and a word, or a count.

when: Showing the state of an item: draft, paid, overdue.
Showing how many items need attention.
Marking a country or language next to its name.

guidance.rule: The word carries the meaning, never the color alone; use sentence case.
Use the bold appearance sparingly, for the one status that matters most.
Use `danger` only for counts that need action now.

builtIn: Text meets WCAG AA in both appearances.
On an icon the badge is hidden; the control's label must say the count.
Hidden from screen readers when the name is next to it.
youProvide: A status word that makes sense without color.
The count in the control's accessible name when the badge sits on an icon.

genui.description: A numeric count next to a label. Use lozenge for status words.

max.description: Above it shows "max+"; default 99, or 9 on an icon.

tone.description:
One meaning per tone: information (Approved, In progress) · brand (Featured) · success
(Completed, Available, Paid) · warning (Payment pending, Under review) · danger (Canceled,
Failed, Overdue) · neutral (Draft, Inactive).

Badge.name: tone
Badge.description:
One meaning per tone: information (Approved, In progress) · brand (Featured) · success
(Completed, Available, Paid) · warning (Payment pending, Under review) · danger (Canceled,
Failed, Overdue) · neutral (Draft, Inactive).

Badge.name: variant
Badge.description:
`subtle` (default): the status of a record in a pill. `bold`: the one status on the screen that needs attention
now. `dot`: a dot and the word, for a live system state (online, syncing).

Badge.name: hasDot
Badge.description: A 6px dot inside a pill (subtle or bold), for live states. `dot` always has its dot.

Badge.name: radius
Badge.description: Pills only (`subtle`, `bold`): corner radius, `none` to `full`; the design's small step (or the provider's default) otherwise.

Badge.name: isLive
Badge.description: `dot` only: a 3px halo for a state that is active right now (connected, syncing).

Badge.name: children
Badge.description: The status word, sentence case ("Payment pending"); the word carries the meaning, never the colour.

Badge.name: aria-label
Badge.description: `dot` only, where a visible word is impossible (a dense table cell with its own column header).

Badge.name: isOnIcon
Badge.description: On an icon inside `BadgeAnchor`: corner placement, and hidden from screen readers (the control's label says it).

Badge.name: max
Badge.description: Above it shows "max+"; default 99, or 9 on an icon.

Badge.name: isDot
Badge.description: An 8px unread marker without a number; hidden from screen readers, so the text or label next to it says "new".
